inputExample.query: What is the capital of France?

usage.outputShape: body.answer (synthesized answer string with inline [n] citation markers); body.citations[].{title,url,publishedDate,image,favicon}; body.costDollars.total; body.requestId
quirks: Required field is `query` (a natural-language question) — this is the answer endpoint, NOT find-similar (which uses `url`)
Answer text contains inline [1][2] citation markers that index into body.citations[]
Some citation entries omit publishedDate/image/favicon; only title and url are reliably populated
Provider-reported costDollars.total ($0.005) is less than the x402 quote charged ($0.010)
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/exa/answer with a JSON body containing {"query": "<your natural-language question>"}. Payment of $0.01 USDC is charged per call on Base via x402 — no API key needed. The response is synchronous: read body.answer for the synthesized answer (which contains inline [n] markers), and body.citations[] for the supporting sources (each has url and title). Use this for direct factual answers with citations rather than raw search results.
